notes.title: Post Release Update 2
notes.content: We've had a fair few comments about the readability of the text in the menu, so aside from fixing various small graphical issues, we are also cleaned up the menu a little bit, made text generally bigger and easier to read.

notes.title: Post Release Update
notes.content:
We've released some balance updates and small bug fixes:

[list]
[*] Smooth strafing - should feel better to move around.
[*] Utility thrown weapon ammo increased across the board.
[*] Small sneaking balance tweak.
[*] Various other small tweaks and fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Release Candidate Change Log
notes.content:
The first release candidate build is now live! 

The build includes a number of changes.

[list]
[*] Animation fixes.
[*] Guard bullets now easier to dodge.
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause the player to get stuck forever.
[*] Glove screens are now easier to see.
[*] Various wording changes.
[*] Various balance changes.
[*] Visual improvements.
[*] Bug Fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Beta Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Various guard balance changes.
[*] Ability to toggle touchpad "touch to move".
[*] Enemy HUD arrows.
[*] Hand rotation changes.
[*] A handy hints page in the loadout select screen.
[*] Various bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: Approved for Release!
notes.content:
After a lot of blood, sweat, and beers, our first game Shadow Uprising is finally approaching release.

After a brief closed beta process, the game will officially be released (mid December), so stay tuned!
